checks: Run UUID, ruleset hash and roster bind v2 match identity; repeated seeds get independent evidence IDs.
Legacy v1 commitments remain identical and a saved partial round resumes without adding runId.
Unknown, missing, null, duplicate, trailing and inconsistent replay fields are rejected.
Reconnect and restart prefer active participant matches over longer completed history.
Observer selection switches the viewed game; observers cannot submit actions or withdraw another player input.
Viewing historical matches cannot bypass active participation or roster exit restrictions.
Roster exits persist and match history cannot reinsert departed players.
Roster, observer and final-round write failures preserve disk state; retries commit exactly one transition.
The owner can withdraw an invalid v1 pending action while preserving all other inputs and completed frames.
Count and aggregate byte budgets apply to both reads and writes; bounded replacement writes remain allowed.
Only operators can prune completed history; active games remain intact and freed capacity allows a new game.
Observer seats can be reclaimed explicitly without changing gameplay state.
Boundary scan and git diff whitespace checks passed.
limits: No new live Paper/Folia client run for this batch; automated unit tests are not human or fairness acceptance.
Manual viewing selection lasts for the connection; persisted memberships drive active-first restart selection.
Initial focused run aborted due to host native memory pressure; the bounded retry and both full builds passed.
Tests ran without forks in a constrained Maven JVM; Java 21 reported a full code cache. No capacity claim.
Worst-case long-match admission against the 8 MiB persistence budget still needs further work.
Signer self-tests used ephemeral keys; no official release signing or real settlement integration.
Other P0-P11 implementation and human/external acceptance items remain open.
